texts.title: An Introduction
texts.body: At a dinner {self.name} is seated beside {match.name} of {match.house}, which may or may not have been arranged by the hostess. The conversation is better than the dinner. Nothing has been said and nothing need be, but {self.name} is unmarried, and it is the kind of evening a courtship can start from.

texts.title: A Rival For The Hand
texts.body: {rival.name} of {rival.house} has begun calling on {beloved.name}. The family receives them both with the same courtesy, which tells {self.name} nothing. {rival.name} has a name and prospects, and no reason to step aside.

choices.outshine_them: Be better company than they are.
choices.a_quiet_word_in_the_right_ear: A quiet word in the right ear.

texts.title: What Are Your Prospects?
texts.body: The head of {beloved.house} asks {self.name} to stay behind after dinner. The question is put kindly and is not kind: what, exactly, does {self.name} have to offer {beloved.name}? A family does not hand over one of its own on the strength of a pleasant manner.

choices.speak_of_what_the_house_will_be: Speak of what the house will be.

texts.title: A Letter Unanswered
texts.body: It is three weeks since {self.name} wrote to {beloved.name} and nothing has come back. It may mean nothing. Letters go astray, families read them first, people are away. It may mean something.

texts.title: The Wedding
texts.body: The contract is agreed and {spouse.name} of {spouse.house} is to be {self.name}'s. What remains is how it is done. A wedding is the one day a house shows everyone what it thinks of itself, and of the person it is marrying.

choices.a_feast_the_city_will_remember: A feast the city will remember.
choices.the_two_families_at_one_table: The two families at one table.

texts.title: Chosen Against
texts.body: It is settled, and not in {self.name}'s favour. The family chose the other suit. There will be a wedding, and {self.name} will be expected to know about it and not to mind.

choices.wish_them_well: Wish them well, and mean it.

texts.title: A Cold House
texts.body: {self.name} and {spouse.name} have dined together four times this month and spoken of the household accounts on each of them. Nobody has done anything wrong. The house is simply cold, and a cold house does not warm by being left alone.

choices.mend_it: Clear a month and mend it.

texts.title: The Affair Is Known
texts.body: {spouse.name} knows. It was a servant, or a letter, or simply the look of the thing; it does not matter which. {spouse.name} has asked {self.name} one question, quietly, and is waiting for the answer.

texts.title: A Marriage Of Two Minds
texts.body: It is noticed, by people who notice such things, that {self.name} and {spouse.name} are happy. They finish each other's arguments. {spouse.name} knows what {self.name} is going to decide before {self.name} does, and is usually right about whether it is wise.

choices.ask_what_they_think: Make a habit of asking what they think.
choices.share_the_weight: Share the weight of the year.
choices.go_away_together: Go away together for a month.

texts.title: The Family Writes
texts.body: A letter comes from {spouse.house}, in the hand of its head and not of a secretary. It is short. They were not asked; they would have said no; their kin has been taken out of their house like a parcel. They want to know what {self.name} proposes to do about it.

choices.send_a_settlement: Send what a dowry would have cost them.

texts.title: The In-Laws Ask A Favour
texts.body: {spouse.name}'s family is short this season and has asked, through {spouse.name}, whether {self.name}'s house could see its way to a loan. Fifteen credits. They are family now, as {spouse.name} does not quite say.

choices.lend_it: Lend it, and say nothing of when.

texts.title: Widowed
texts.body: The house is quiet in a way it has not been before. The marriage is over because one of the two people in it is dead, and {self.name} is the one left to decide what the household does now.

texts.title: Married Without Your Leave
texts.body: {kin.name} is married. {self.name} hears it from a clerk, who had it from the registry, where it was entered three days ago. Nobody of either family was asked. {kin.name} knew what the answer would be and decided not to need it.
